Long press and drag a button to change the order. The switch chooses whether the button is shown on the toolbar. The Settings button is always last.

Press and hold a character, then drag it to a new position, also across pages.
Restore the symbols to their default order?
Add a space after a suggestion
Most common words when nothing is typed
Corrects an unknown word to the closest known word when you press space; backspace undoes the correction. Corrections are mainly Finnish.
Browse, pin, allow and remove learned words

The keyboard learns the words you type or choose from the suggestion row. Tap a word in this list to pin it (it stays at the top of the suggestions), block it or remove it. While typing, a long press on a word in the suggestion row offers the same actions.
Remove all learned words, word sequences and emoji history? This cannot be undone.
An API key is not the same as a Claude or ChatGPT subscription

AI translation and OpenAI dictation use the service\'s own API key. API use is billed separately by usage and is not included in a Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus subscription. You can get a key at platform.claude.com (Claude) or platform.openai.com (OpenAI).\n\nYou cannot sign in with a Claude subscription: Anthropic does not allow it for other apps. You can sign in below with a ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription: AI translation then uses your subscription\'s quota and no API key is needed. OpenAI dictation always requires an OpenAI API key; the device\'s own speech recognition works without a key.

ARK-Keyboard learns your own words, word pairs and way of writing — entirely on your device. Text leaves the device only if you use AI translation or OpenAI dictation yourself.
The keyboard is enabled in two steps in your phone\'s settings.

The suggestion row completes and predicts words, and your own words rise to the top from the first time you use them. A long press on a suggestion removes or blocks the word, and you can manage everything learned in the settings.
The top row has dictation, the clipboard, the translator and emoji. You can change the order and visibility of the buttons in the settings.
Happy typing! All settings, learned word management and backups are in this app.
Dictation ends by itself after a pause of this length.

In use: %1$s.\nTap to choose between the device\'s recognition and OpenAI recognition. OpenAI is often more accurate and does not stop listening in noise; speech is streamed to OpenAI with your own key, and the text appears in the field as you speak. Your most used learned words are also sent, so that your own names and terms are recognised correctly. One dictation lasts five minutes at most.
